name: zinput_bindmap_context_set_joystick_binding
description: zInput_BindMapContext::SetJoystickBinding updates a command's joystick slot and the reverse slot-to-command lookup.
known_limits: tier S verification is accepted by the zinput_bindmap_joystick_binding_wrappers VC target.
functional_evidence: Native smoke zinput_bindmap_context_smoke changes command 3's joystick slot through the current-context wrapper and verifies the new slot maps to command 3 and the packed joystick-slot getter returns the new slot.

Binary Ninja assembly for 0x470bf0 clears the packed joystick field for the old command occupying a nonzero slot, writes the reverse joystick-slot lookup, returns early for commandId zero, clears the command's previous joystick slot lookup, and writes the new four-bit joystick slot into the packed binding record.
